entities.name: Reliable Data Service
entities.description: A service for reliable data transfer supported by the UE, requested during PDU session establishment and subject to network acceptance.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests establishment of a PDU session, including optional Reliable Data Service usage.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information Element used by the UE to request Reliable Data Service and by the network to indicate acceptance.

entities.name: Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation indicator
entities.description: Indicator that must be set for PDU sessions to use Reliable Data Service, or when using control plane CIoT 5GS optimization without moving to user plane.

entities.name: Reliable Data Service acceptance condition
entities.description: Condition where the network accepts the UE's request to use Reliable Data Service for a PDU session.

entities.name: Reliable Data Service exclusive usage
entities.description: Property that the UE must use the PDU session exclusively for Reliable Data Service if accepted by the network.

relations.description: UE may request Reliable Data Service during UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is used to request and indicate acceptance of Reliable Data Service.
Reliable Data Service may only be used if Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation indicator is set or under specific control plane optimization conditions.
If the network accepts Reliable Data Service, the UE must use the PDU session exclusively for it.
Extended protocol configuration options IE conveys the network's acceptance of Reliable Data Service usage.
